dismissals.because: src/forge/merge.py:128 archiving exists to tidy the owner's chat list; merge archives every conversation in the item's record and turn log, and the one it can miss is a conversation that was created but never ran a turn before a retry, which holds no work; leaving that empty chat unarchived is harmless, and recording every created conversation would change how every worker round records chats, outside this task

findings.body: A conversation is missed when the first worker attempt stops after creating its thread but before starting a turn, and the worker is then retried. `codex.py:192–194` clears the pending record without logging that conversation; `codex.py:156–157` then requests a fresh conversation, and `codex.py:311` overwrites the previous ID. This collector reads only the latest record and turn log, so merge succeeds while leaving the earlier recorded conversation unarchived. Preserve conversation IDs independently of whether a turn starts, and extend the CLI test to retry the interrupted worker with a different conversation before merging.
findings.title: Not done: 5. Archive every recorded Codex conversation
